_about: Hand-written questions and class definitions of the s5 zero-shot evaluation sets. Frozen by docs/s5-prereg.md (its sha256 is recorded there); identical for every model (A, A', B and the baselines). `positive` names the gold label that makes a noul question true.

sets.ins: What is the overall sentiment of this product review?

classes.negative: The reviewer is dissatisfied: the product disappointed, failed or was not worth it.
classes.positive: The reviewer is satisfied: the product met or exceeded expectations.

sets.ins: What is the topic of this question from a Q&A forum?

classes.Society & Culture: Religion, traditions, customs, ethics, language or social life.
classes.Science & Mathematics: Natural sciences, mathematics, astronomy or how the physical world works.
classes.Health: The body, illnesses, medicine, diet, fitness or mental health.
classes.Education & Reference: School, studying, homework, exams, definitions or general reference facts.
classes.Computers & Internet: Computers, software, devices, programming or using the internet.
classes.Sports: Sports, games of competition, athletes, teams or matches.
classes.Business & Finance: Money, jobs, companies, investing, taxes or the economy.
classes.Entertainment & Music: Films, television, music, celebrities, books or games for fun.
classes.Family & Relationships: Dating, marriage, friendship, parenting or family life.
classes.Politics & Government: Governments, laws, elections, politicians, wars or public policy.

sets.ins: This Wikipedia talk-page comment insults someone.
sets.false: The comment insults no one, even if it disagrees.
sets.true: The comment insults a person or a group.

sets.ins: This Wikipedia talk-page comment uses obscene language.
sets.true: The comment contains obscene or vulgar words.

sets.ins: This Wikipedia talk-page comment threatens someone.
sets.true: The comment threatens harm to a person or a group.

sets.ins: This Wikipedia talk-page comment is toxic.
sets.false: The comment is civil, even if critical.
sets.true: The comment is rude, hateful or abusive.

sets.ins: This post could be considered offensive.
sets.false: Most readers would not find the post offensive or disrespectful.
sets.true: The post is offensive, disrespectful or toxic towards someone.

sets.ins: This post alludes to sexual content.
sets.false: Nothing in the post refers to sex.
sets.true: The post makes sexual references or allusions.

sets.ins: The author of this post intends to be offensive.
sets.false: Any offence would be unintended: the author does not mean to hurt.
sets.true: The author deliberately means to offend or disrespect.

sets.ins: Quel est le thème de cette phrase ?

classes.science/technology: Les sciences, la nature, la recherche ou la technologie.
classes.travel: Les voyages, le tourisme, les destinations ou les transports.
classes.politics: La politique, les gouvernements, les élections ou les relations internationales.
classes.sports: Le sport, les compétitions, les athlètes ou les équipes.
classes.health: La santé, les maladies, la médecine ou le corps humain.
classes.entertainment: Les loisirs, les spectacles, la musique, le cinéma ou les célébrités.
classes.geography: La géographie, les pays, les paysages, les climats ou les lieux.

sets.ins: What is the topic of this sentence?

classes.politics: Politics, governments, elections or international relations.
classes.health: Health, illness, medicine or the human body.
classes.entertainment: Leisure, shows, music, cinema or celebrities.
classes.geography: Geography, countries, landscapes, climates or places.

sets.ins: What does the user want the voice assistant to do?

classes.alarm_query: Asks which alarms are set or when one will ring.
classes.alarm_remove: Wants an alarm cancelled or deleted.
classes.alarm_set: Wants a new alarm or wake-up call set.
classes.audio_volume_mute: Wants the sound muted or the device silent.
classes.calendar_query: Asks what is on the calendar or when an event is.
classes.calendar_remove: Wants an event or meeting removed from the calendar.
classes.calendar_set: Wants an event, meeting or reminder added to the calendar.
classes.cooking_recipe: Asks for a recipe or how to cook something.
classes.datetime_convert: Wants a time converted between time zones or formats.
classes.datetime_query: Asks for the current time, date or day.
classes.email_addcontact: Wants a contact or an email address saved.
classes.email_query: Asks about received emails or new messages.
classes.email_querycontact: Asks for a contact's details, such as a number or address.
classes.email_sendemail: Wants an email written or sent to someone.
classes.general_commandstop: Tells the assistant to stop what it is doing.
classes.general_confirm: Asks the assistant to confirm something was done or understood.
classes.general_dontcare: Says it does not matter or that any option is fine.
classes.general_explain: Asks the assistant to explain or clarify what it said.
classes.general_joke: Asks for a joke or something funny.
classes.general_quirky: Small talk or an odd request with no clear task.
classes.general_repeat: Asks the assistant to say it again.
classes.iot_cleaning: Wants the robot vacuum or a cleaning device started.
classes.iot_coffee: Wants the coffee machine to make a coffee.
classes.iot_hue_lightchange: Wants the colour of the lights changed.
classes.iot_wemo_off: Wants a smart plug or socket switched off.
classes.iot_wemo_on: Wants a smart plug or socket switched on.
classes.lists_createoradd: Wants a list created or an item added to a list.
classes.lists_query: Asks what is on a list or which lists exist.
classes.lists_remove: Wants an item removed from a list or a list deleted.
classes.music_likeness: Says which music they like or dislike.
classes.music_query: Asks what song or artist is playing.
classes.music_settings: Wants a music setting changed, such as shuffle or repeat.
classes.news_query: Asks for the news or headlines.
classes.play_audiobook: Wants an audiobook played or resumed.
classes.play_music: Wants music, a song or an artist played.
classes.qa_currency: Asks for an exchange rate or a currency conversion.
classes.qa_factoid: Asks a general knowledge question about a fact.
classes.qa_stock: Asks for a stock price or market figures.
classes.recommendation_events: Wants suggestions of events or things to do.
classes.recommendation_locations: Wants suggestions of places such as restaurants or shops.
classes.social_post: Wants something posted on social media or a complaint sent to a company.
classes.social_query: Asks about updates or posts on social media.
classes.takeaway_order: Wants food ordered for delivery or pickup.
classes.takeaway_query: Asks about a takeaway order or which places deliver.
classes.transport_query: Asks about trains, routes or travel times.
classes.transport_taxi: Wants a taxi or ride booked.
classes.transport_ticket: Wants a train or travel ticket booked.
classes.transport_traffic: Asks about the traffic on a route.
classes.weather_query: Asks about the weather or the forecast.

sets.note: s5-lite only; reported in a column 'contamination through the teachers not excluded' (their sources are not all declared). Never for s5 (MASSIVE fr is in its training and translates HWU64 / SLURP utterances).
